sections.content: Deepfleet is building interoperable, resilient technology for EV charging. Our EV Roaming technology helps EV drivers find & use 20x more chargers around them. We are looking for a Founding Software Engineer  to join the team. If the idea of being part of an innovative, high-impact EV startup interests you, please apply.

sections.heading: About the Role
sections.content:
This role isn’t easy. You will thrive if you have
High-agency
Curiosity to learn (especially when the learning curve is steep) & execute
Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
Ability to see the future (Alright, this one’s a joke!)
2+ years of industry experience.
Excellent knowledge in Typescript / Javascript and frameworks like Next.js,React  
Good knowledge in MySQL , Redis 
Good understanding of data structures and algorithms. 
Not mandatory but it’s definitely super plus to have knowledge in EV ecosystem components.

You will be working with the founding team on our universal EV charging interoperability protocol OCPPPlus (OCP3). You will be using Typescript, React, Nextjs, MySQL & Redis. It will be great if you know about industry specific OCPP, OCPI and Vehicle-to-EVSE protocols. That said, we value learnability more than experience and skill.

sections.heading: Team Values
sections.content:
Deepfleet is founded by industry leaders with vast experience in taking companies through the zero-to-one journey. We believe our team is our biggest asset.
At Deepfleet we discuss ferociously about how to save a rupee for our charging infra partners, how to make charging experience multiple magnitudes better for the vehicle driver or how to make dashboards easy to read. Well, you get the point.
Deepfleet is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes candidates from all backgrounds to apply. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

sections.heading: What We Offer
sections.content:
Competitive stipend and benefits package.
The opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology in the rapidly growing EV industry.
A collaborative and innovative work environment.
Frequent team-building activities and outings.
(EV) Commute perks.
Industry best compensation packages.

sections.heading: Additional Details
sections.content:
Openings: 1
Location: State of the art office in EPIP Zone, Whitefield, Bangalore, walkable from purple line metro stations.
Work days: 5 days a week
Compensation : Industry Best 
Commute Perks: NCMC Cards for Commute (Loaded Monthly)
